bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
w=/home/admin1/projects/ai-core/.worktrees/pr3-verification-20261015
test "$(git -C "$w" rev-parse HEAD)" = d6a11e719c39684334d5b432bfddd0d70e5c1c39

git -C "$w" fetch --no-tags origin feat/per-model-lifecycle-20261013 >/dev/null 2>&1
test "$(git -C "$w" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = 13c0cb2079aab87aa5db4ef27c0f1f9adcc8886d

docker run --rm --network none --cpus 1 --memory 512m -v "$w:/src:ro" -w /src -e PYTHONPATH=/src --entrypoint python3 ai-core-model-gate:offline-d6a11e71 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_model_gate.py -k stream_metrics -v

want=$(sha256sum "$w/runtime/model_gate.py" | cut -d ' ' -f1)
got=$(docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint sha256sum ai-core-model-gate:offline-13c0cb20 /app/runtime/model_gate.py | cut -d ' ' -f1)
test "$want" = "$got"
echo AI_CORE_STREAM_COMPLETION_AND_OFFLINE_IMAGE=PASS
